description: Ashley reveals that they broke up the previous year over the same work-related emotional distance, but agreed to try again.

openingMessages.speaker: Ashley
openingMessages.text: I've been thinking about Friday. I wasn't trying to start another argument. I just wanted us to finally talk about things.

choices.text: You said this wasn't the first time we'd had this conversation. What did you mean?
So this is all my fault, then?

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: ...Bjarne, we broke up last year. Do you remember that?

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: I couldn't keep doing it the way things were. I felt like I was constantly competing with your work, and eventually I just couldn't take it anymore.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: You came back after a while and asked if we could try again. I agreed because I still loved you. I really did want things to work out.

choices.text: I didn't realize we'd been through all that.
Why did you decide to give me another chance?
I'm sorry you had to go through that.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: Yes, Bjarne. Last year. And it wasn't easy for either of us.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: You asked me to give us another chance, and I did. I really thought we'd make it work this time.

choices.text: Why did you give me another chance?
I'm sorry. I didn't understand how much we'd been through.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: That's not what I said. I'm not trying to make you feel guilty.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: I'm trying to explain why this hurts so much. I thought we'd already gotten past this.

choices.text: I know. I shouldn't have gotten defensive.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: That's what hurts. It feels like I remember every difficult conversation we've had, and you remember none of them.

choices.text: What did I promise would change?

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: Because I believed you. You told me things would be different.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: I wanted to believe we could get back to what we used to have.

choices.text: What did I promise would change?

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: Thank you. I just wish you had understood how close I was to leaving for good.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: You promised to make more time for us.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: You promised that work wouldn't always come first.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: And you promised you'd actually talk to me when something was wrong instead of pretending everything was fine.

lines.speaker: Detective
lines.text: This is not an isolated incident. It's a recurring pattern.

lines.speaker: Grand Architect
lines.text: A recurring failure requires more than a temporary patch.

lines.speaker: Pragmatist
lines.text: Well, at least the relationship has version history. Unfortunately, the previous release also had bugs.

choices.text: I wish I'd kept those promises.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: I appreciate you saying that. I just need you to hear me without turning it into an argument.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: I don't know what happens next, Bjarne. I just hope things can be different this time.
